column15: {=ARM_KR_000_1_U}A tired raven lands on the sill of the rookery with a strip of parchment tied to its leg. The maester reads it twice by candlelight, then sends a boy to wake whoever keeps the keys tonight. In uncertain times small news travels fast, and every lord wants to hear it first.
column16: {=ARM_KR_000_1_L}This is a test window of the Chronicle of Westeros. It checks that a story window opens on the map, shows a picture from its theme and closes cleanly.

column15: {=ARM_KR_000_1a_U}Snow clings to the wings of the raven as it drops into the rookery of a northern keep. The message is short and smudged by the cold: the roads south are still open, but the lords of the North are counting their men and their winter stores.
column16: {=ARM_KR_000_1a_L}Test variant: you see this text because your party stands on the lands of the North. Anywhere else the same window shows its base text.

column15: {=ARM_KR_000_2_U}Merchants on the kingsroad speak of little but the Hand of the King held in the black cells under the Red Keep. In Winterfell young Robb Stark reads his mother's letters again and again, and his bannermen wait for the word that will send them south.
column16: {=ARM_KR_000_2_L}Test window with a choice: when it closes, a list of three answers appears. The second answer stays greyed out unless Robb Stark already thinks well of you.
column18: {=ARM_KR_000_2_Q}How do you answer the young lord of Winterfell?

column15: {=ARM_KR_000_6_U}A royal messenger in a mud-stained cloak rides through the gate with a sealed letter. It bears the seal of {KING}, and the steward reads it aloud in the yard: the crown asks every lord to keep the roads safe and the granaries full before the cold months.
column16: {=ARM_KR_000_6_L}Test window with variables: the title and the first paragraph name the ruler of the Crownlands, and this line names you, {ME}. A hidden full-version variant must not show here.

column3: {=ARM_KR_000_2_Ca}Send him a purse of silver for his host
column4: {=ARM_KR_000_2_Ha}You pay 200 denars from your own purse to Robb Stark. His opinion of you rises a little.

column3: {=ARM_KR_000_2_Cb}Ride north and offer him your sword
column4: {=ARM_KR_000_2_Hb}Needs a good standing with Robb Stark (relation 50 or more). His opinion of you rises.
{=ARM_KR_000_2_Hc}Nothing changes. Most lords of the realm chose to wait and see.
